component.name: Stash Player
component.summary: Desktop client for the Stash media server

description.p: Stash Player is a desktop client for the Stash media server. Browse and filter your library, then play scenes locally with hardware-accelerated video.

ul.li: Library grid with search, sorting, rating and tracking filters
Local playback via libmpv with VA-API where available
Resume position, play count, rating and O-counter synced back to Stash
Optional SOCKS proxy for servers reachable only over a tailnet

description.p: Stash Player has a new, rebuilt client. Your saved server connection is imported automatically on first launch.

ul.li: Library browse with search, sort and filtering
Inline scene player with mpv-style keyboard shortcuts
Settings page with Stash URL and API key entry
